name: Voronoi Biome Blending
definition: A procedural terrain generation technique using Voronoi cells to define macro-biomes, blended using smoothstep to create smooth transitions between biomes.
summary: Voronoi Biome Blending is a procedural terrain technique using Voronoi cells and smoothstep interpolation to create seamless biome transitions, distinguishing itself by ensuring contiguous macro-climates.
